name: adamschaefers.com
description: The toolchain, pinned here for CI and local use (make drives it): TypeScript checks the code, esbuild bundles js/app.ts and the Workers' admin pages, Tailwind compiles the styles, wrangler serves and deploys (npx wrangler -c <worker>/wrangler.jsonc). lit-html and the fonts are the site's own dependencies, bundled and copied by make build.
